name: Map Provider
description: Map provider manager. Allow developers to use and define multiple map providers using the Drupal 8 Plugin API. Also include a render element to display a map provider using Leaflet.
project_description:
Map provider module allow developers to use and define many map providers. But by default module supports Open Street Map (OSM) provider.

 Map provider using the Drupal 8 - Drupal 9 Plugin API. It is lighter than other modules that embed many map providers 

 It's also include a render element to display a map provider using Leaflet.

 Dependencies 
 No dependencies

 See Installing contributed modules .
